content: Eesawera Yaaqoobe Gayteth
Yaaqoobey dhoqqu gi xeellidi Eesawey 400 as banara ekki yizayssa be7ides; hessa gishshas nayta Liyas, Eraheelissinne nam7u aylletas shaakki shaakki immides.
Ashkaratanne istta nayta sinththan Liyanne izi nayta isttafe guyen Eraheelonne Yooseefe wurseththan woththides.
Gido attiin izi ba baggara ubbaafe sinththe aadhdhidi ba ishaakko matida wode laappunto ziggides.
Eesawey gidikko izara gaagganaas woxxidi iza qoodhe bolla xaaxettidi yeerides; nam7atikka yeekkida.
Hessafe guye Eesawey dhoqqu gi xeellidi maccassatanne nayta be7idi, «Ha nenara dizayti oonanttee?» gi oychchides. Yaaqoobey izas, «Hayti Xoossi ne aylles taas ba kiyateththan immida nayta» gides.
Hessafe guye aylleti ba naytara shiiqidi iza sinththan ziggida.
Kaallidi Liyaynne izi nayti yiidi ziggida; wurseththan Yooseefeynne Eraheela yiidi ziggida.
Eesawey, «Sinththan tanara gaaggida mehey wuri aaza mehee?» gi oychchides. Izikka, «Ta godoo! Hayssi ne tana ufayssan mokka ekkanaassa» gides.
Eesawey, «Ta ishoo! Taas daro haaroy dees; ne miishshi nees gido» gides.
Yaaqoobey, «Akkay, ha7i ne tana mokka ekkanaa gidikko ta nees immizayssa ekka; ne tana siiqon mokka ekkishin ta be7idayssa Xoossa ayfeso be7ida mala qoodays.
Xoossi ba kiyateththan ubbaa kunththi taas immida gishshas koshshizaazi ubbay taas dees; ta nees immizayssa ekkarkkii» giidi Yaaqoobey minththi shoobbida gishshas Eesawey izi gidayssa ekkides.
Hessafe guye Eesawey, «Denda ane boos; tanikka inttenara issife baana» gides.

Gido attiin Yaaqoobey iza, «Ta godoo! Ne be7iza mala nayti shugo gididayssa ne eraasa; qasse tani galo maratanne guuththa laaqqata dhanththiza dorsatanne miizata naagana koshshees; istti elle elle laaggiko meheti wuri issi gallas hayqqi wurana.
Hessa gishshas ta godoo neni taappe sinththatada ba; ta sinththan diza meheynne nayti hemettana dandayza keena hemettidi nenara Seyren gayttana» gides.
Eesawey iza, «Histtiko tani ta asaappe guuththata nees ashshays» gides. Gido attiin Yaaqoobey iza, «Hessi ayssee? Tani ta godaa sinththan bonchchettidayssi taas gidana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Eesawey he gallas Seyre simmi bides.
Gido attiin Yaaqoobey Sukoote bides; heen baas keeth keexxides; ba mehetaska aqizaso giigsides; hessa gishshas he sohoza Sukoote
gi sunththides.
Yaaqoobey Mesphexoomiyappe simmida wode Kanaane biittan diza Seekeeme giza katama saron gakkides; katamays sinththa baggara diza dembaan dunkaani uttides.
Ba Dunkaaneza tolida gadeza Seekeeme aawa Emoore naytappe 100 saqile biran shammides.
Heen yarshosoho keexxidi iza, «Xoossi Isra7eele Xoossa» gi sunththides.

footnotes.text: Sukoote: Sukoote guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Daase woykko aqoso» guussa.
